name: m2-01-multilingual-retrieval-labels-v1
description: Hand-labelled small corpus for M2-01 retrieval plumbing. Labels were fixed before running the harness. `relevant` lists exact page-text sentences; an empty list marks an unanswerable query.

lines: The project has three stages: ingestion, retrieval, and evidence verification.
Ingestion converts each PDF page into traceable text.
Photos are encrypted before upload and stored with a random identifier.
The preview image is generated only after the security check.
Retrieval latency is measured for every semantic query.
The evaluation report records each latency result.
